purpose: prospective extension after the v0.1 source-length study failed its frozen convergence and directional-confirmation rules

amendment_provenance.reason_for_amendment: at pass 3000 the 250-pass window passed 6/6 runs, while the 500, 750, and 1000-pass windows passed 5/6, 2/6, and 1/6; shortening the window would create an unstable success criterion
amendment_provenance.predecessor_verdict_remains: v0.1 study convergence and conditional directional confirmation both failed and are not replaced by v0.2

pair_provenance.selection_rule: unchanged from v0.1: maximum nonnegative-barrier aggregate-rate ratio within the frozen 0.25 meV mean-barrier tolerance at comp=0.9

simulation.restart_policy: rerun every seed-structure shard from initialization; do not resume selectively from v0.1

primary_endpoint.name: late_window_median_conductivity_mS_cm
primary_endpoint.paired_contrast: high_initial_rate_structure divided by low_initial_rate_structure within seed
primary_endpoint.directional_confirmation_rule: all three paired ratios exceed 1 only after both runs in every pair pass the v0.2 convergence gate

convergence_gate.relative_drift_definition: absolute difference between late and preceding window medians divided by max(abs(late median), 1e-30)
convergence_gate.run_pass_rule: all four metrics are finite throughout both 1000-pass windows and satisfy their frozen drift threshold
convergence_gate.pair_pass_rule: both structure runs for a seed pass
convergence_gate.study_pass_rule: all six runs and all three seed pairs pass
convergence_gate.diagnostic_only_rule: report but never substitute these windows for the frozen 1000-pass gate

reporting_policy: retain and cite the failed v0.1 result alongside v0.2
retain all v0.2 seeds, direction reversals, non-finite values, and failed convergence gates
report per-pass curves and all frozen window medians for every run
report paired ratios individually; three seeds do not justify asymptotic significance claims
do not describe a failed directional rule as evidence of equal conductivity
do not choose a diagnostic-only window after observing outcomes
interpretation_boundary: This extension can test convergence and transport ordering inside the pinned fitted kMC model. It cannot identify a physical mechanism, validate the fitted energy landscape, establish population-level generality, or establish experimental pellet conductivity.
sealed_test_interaction: This extension does not access or alter the paper-level sealed claim benchmark.
